people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.
translations.bsb: Suddenly Jesus met them and said, “Greetings!” They came to Him, grasped His feet, and worshiped Him.
translations.kjv: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
translations.asv: And behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and took hold of his feet, and worshipped him.
